headline: On October 22, 1992: Space Shuttle Columbia launches on STS-52
captionCards: Columbia was 3,600 kg heavier than Endeavour
instagramCaption:
Space Shuttle Columbia embarks on a critical mission. \\[Columbia launched on STS-52 to deploy the LAGEOS-2 satellite and conduct microgravity experiments. This was one of many missions for the first reusable spacecraft, which was also the heaviest of the five spacefaring orbiters. The mission's success furthered our understanding of Earth's geodynamics.\\Why it still matters: It advanced scientific research and satellite technology.\\What do you think was the most significant outcome of this mission?\\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
